- scripts/attempt_journal.py:520-575 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `cmd_append()` / `append()` reads the comments, parses them, builds a new body and then PATCHes or POSTs it, with no lock, version check or single-writer guard.
  WHY: Two runs that overlap on the same issue (for example implement.yml's "Record attempt journal entry (implement)" step and the review_autofix.yml run started by the PR push) can each overwrite the other's entry. If neither run finds an existing journal, both POST, and the older comment then disappears from view because parse() keeps only the newest trusted comment. glm rated this MAJOR; gemini gave no severity. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disagreed and chose not to re-raise it: the issue predates the last run, the code fails open and nothing gates on the journal.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:447-451 (also scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:405-409) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `sed -n '/^=== ATTEMPT JOURNAL REPAIR RULES ===$/,$p' "${rules}" || true` prints nothing when the rules file exists but its marker header is missing or changed, and the code does not log `PERSIST journal outcome=skipped reason=rules_absent`.
  WHY: The repair prompt then loses the update-the-test-versus-restore rules with no log line, because the rules_absent branch only runs when the file is missing or empty. minimax and glm rated this NIT; gemini gave no severity. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 raised the same point only as a hardening suggestion.

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/attempt_journal.py:520-575 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `append()` does an unsynchronised read-modify-write: it loads the comments, parses them, builds a comment and then patches or posts it.
  WHY: Overlapping runs read the same state and the last write silently overwrites earlier updates. If both runs see no journal, both POST, which creates duplicate journal comments and confuses readers that trust only the newest comment.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh, line 448; also scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh, line 406 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `sed -n '/^=== ATTEMPT JOURNAL REPAIR RULES ===$/,$p' "${rules}" || true` fails silently when the rules file exists but its marker header is missing, malformed or changed.
  WHY: The repair prompt silently drops the journal repair rules, so the model may restore deliberately deleted code instead of updating the tests, and the `reason=rules_absent` log never fires.
- TASK_GAP

  Expected change site: Tests in tests/test_workflow_untrusted_input_contract.py, or a new P1 test file, that render and compare the plan, implement and review-editor prompts with `PERSIST_JOURNAL_ENABLED` set to 'false' versus unset.
  Evidence of absence: Byte-identity tests exist only for the gate repair prompts (`test_journal_off_repair_prompt_is_byte_identical`, `test_journal_off_prompt_is_byte_identical`) and for the unblock judge context (`test_unblock_journal_merge_adds_the_field_only_when_on`).
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
